notes: The temporal בְּ is unrepresented under rule 40 because the ASV writes the phrase as a bare adverbial 'Every day'; rule 40's fusion clause does not reach it, since כֹּל and יוֹם each keep an English word of their own.
כָל־יוֹם is rendered attributively under rule 28, so no 'of' is written for the chain.
